structure: Part 1, "The whole ruling file": every one of the 18 lines of `workareas/shared/design-release-2-1/sources/ruling-paul-2026-10-14.md`, read in full. The file is the standard ruling layout: a title line ("# Ruling: Paul, 14 October 2026"), a status note ("To confirm with Sam. Given while starting the address-book theme ahead of the team's go-ahead, so its rows can build."), one framing line naming what is ruled on ("14 October, on inc-062 dropping County from the address book's add-details step:"), the ruling itself as a single blockquote of three words ("> Keep County."), and a "## Claims" section with two numbered claims written by the main session — claim 1 the decision (the add-details step keeps a 'County (optional)' field between 'Town or city' and 'Postcode or Zip code', as the edit page inc-073 and the view page inc-064 already do, replacing inc-062's criterion "The add-details step has no County field"), claim 2 its ground (the V4 "Live Animals & Germinals Data Fields - V4" Address Block on `confluence:6497338582` gives every address block the same fields including County and outranks the prototype, so a Design Release 2.1 page leaving County out is a prototype mistake per the EUDPA-646 ruling of 1 October 2026; and an add form that cannot set a field the record, the view and the edit form all carry would lose data on a round trip). Covered here: the status note, the framing line, the three-word quote, both numbered claims broken into one claim per fact (field kept, label and its optional status, position in the field order, the neighbouring fields, the edit page, the view page, the criterion it replaces, the V4 Address Block ground, V4's rank over the prototype, the prototype-mistake rule, the round-trip data-loss ground), and four gaps for what the ruling leaves open. The quote is three words, so almost everything the file says is the main session's reading of it: each statement is checked back against "Keep County." read with the framing line, and marked verbatim only where those words carry it, inferred otherwise. The two cross-referenced documents (the V4 Confluence page `confluence:6497338582`, the 1 October 2026 EUDPA-646 ruling) are separate sources in this programme and were read as citations only, never opened.

claims.statement: The ruling is not yet confirmed: it is to be confirmed with Sam.
claims.note: Recorded so the reconciler knows the decision is unconfirmed at the time of writing, and weighs it accordingly against later rulings.

claims.statement: The ruling was given while the address-book theme was being started, ahead of the team's go-ahead, so that the theme's rows can be built.
claims.quote: Given while starting the address-book theme ahead of the team's go-ahead, so its rows can build.

claims.statement: Before this ruling, backlog row inc-062 dropped the County field from the address book's add-details step.
claims.quote: 14 October, on inc-062 dropping County from the address book's add-details step:
claims.note: The framing line names what the three-word quote rules on: the page is the address book's add-details step, and the row is inc-062.

claims.statement: The address book's add-details step keeps its County field; it is not removed.
claims.ref: ruling-paul-2026-10-14.md line 7 (the quote), with line 5 and claim 1
claims.note: The decision itself. The framing line on line 5 supplies the page and step the three words apply to.

claims.statement: The County field on the address book's add-details step is labelled 'County (optional)'.
claims.quote: The address book's add-details step keeps a 'County (optional)' field
claims.note: The ruling's own words are only "Keep County.", which give no label. The label follows from "keep" meaning the field stays as the record, the view page and the edit page already carry it, and is the main session's reading recorded in claim 1.

claims.statement: County on the address book's add-details step is optional: the trader can leave it blank.
claims.note: Follows from the "(optional)" suffix in the label claim 1 gives; the three-word quote says nothing about whether the field is mandatory.

claims.statement: County sits between 'Town or city' and 'Postcode or Zip code' in the add-details step's field order.
claims.quote:
keeps a 'County (optional)' field between 'Town or city' and 'Postcode or Zip
   code'
claims.note: The quote "Keep County." gives no position; the position is the main session's reading in claim 1, matching where the edit and view pages already carry the field.

claims.statement: The address book's add-details step has a 'Town or city' field and a 'Postcode or Zip code' field.
claims.quote:
between 'Town or city' and 'Postcode or Zip
   code'
claims.note: Implied by claim 1 naming them as the fields County sits between; the ruling does not assert them directly.

claims.statement: The address book's edit page already has a County field (backlog row inc-073).
claims.quote: as the edit page (inc-073) and the view page (inc-064) already do
claims.note: A statement of existing state in the main session's claim 1, not in the three-word quote.

claims.statement: The address book's view page already shows a County field (backlog row inc-064).
claims.quote: as the edit page (inc-073) and the view page (inc-064) already do
claims.note: A statement of existing state in the main session's claim 1, not in the three-word quote.

claims.statement: This decision replaces inc-062's acceptance criterion "The add-details step has no County field".
claims.quote:
Replaces inc-062's criterion "The
   add-details step has no County field".
claims.note: Answers the conflict the framing line names: inc-062 dropping County from the address book's add-details step. The quote "Keep County.", read with that framing line, decides it directly.

claims.statement: The V4 data dictionary's Address Block gives every address block the same fields, County included.
claims.quote:
the Confluence page "Live Animals & Germinals Data Fields - V4" (`confluence:6497338582`, Address Block) gives
   every address block the same fields, County included
claims.note: The ground the main session records for the ruling, not words from the three-word quote. `confluence:6497338582` is a separate source in this programme and is authoritative for the Address Block's own fields; it was not opened here.

claims.statement: The V4 data dictionary ranks above the prototype, so where the two disagree on a field V4 decides.
claims.quote: and it ranks above the prototype
claims.note: Part of the recorded ground rather than the three-word quote.

claims.statement: Where a Design Release 2.1 page leaves County out, that omission is a prototype mistake rather than a requirement.
claims.quote:
Where a Design Release 2.1
   page leaves County out, that is a prototype mistake (EUDPA-646 ruling, 1 October 2026,
   `workareas/shared/catch-up-address-book-with-prototype-21/sources/ruling-paul-2026-10-01.md`).
claims.note: Cited to the earlier EUDPA-646 ruling of 1 October 2026 in the catch-up-address-book-with-prototype-21 workarea, which was not opened here. Part of the recorded ground, not the three-word quote.

claims.statement: An add form that cannot set a field the record, the view page and the edit form all carry would lose that data on a round trip.
claims.quote:
An add form that
   cannot set a field the record, the view and the edit form all carry would also lose data on a round trip.
claims.note: The second ground recorded by the main session; the three-word quote does not say it.

claims.statement: The ruling does not say what Sam's confirmation would change, nor what happens to the decision and the rows built on it if Sam does not confirm it.
claims.note: The file marks the ruling "To confirm with Sam" and is silent on the consequence either way.

claims.statement: The ruling does not say whether County must also be added on any other page where Design Release 2.1 omits it; it decides only the address book's add-details step.
claims.ref: ruling-paul-2026-10-14.md claim 2 read against the framing line on line 5
claims.note: Claim 2's ground is general ("Where a Design Release 2.1 page leaves County out, that is a prototype mistake"), but the decision the quote makes is scoped to the one step the framing line names. Whether the general ground reaches other address-entry pages is left open.

claims.statement: The ruling does not say whether 'optional' means optional to proceed, optional to submit, or both.
claims.note: The programme distinguishes mandatory to proceed from mandatory to submit; the label '(optional)' alone does not settle which sense applies.

claims.statement: The ruling does not say the County field's format, maximum length or validation.
claims.note: Recorded as an open point for the increment. The ruling's own ground points at the V4 Address Block (`confluence:6497338582`) as the owner of a field's format and limits, so the reconciler should take them from there rather than from this ruling.
